LESSON: QUALITIES OF ENLIGHTENED BEINGS

Grade: Grade 1
Subject: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Manifestations
Topic 3.1: Qualities Of Enlightened Beings

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Qualities Of Enlightened Beings. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. appreciate the qualities Parvati Mata, of the Enlightened Lakshmi Mata Beings as loving and Durga Mata 3.2 Belief in caring in groups. paramatma

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. appreciate the qualities Parvati Mata, of the Enlightened Lakshmi Mata Beings as loving and Durga Mata 3.2 Belief in caring in groups. paramatma
   In simple words: practise until you can appreciate the qualities Parvati Mata, of the Enlightened Lakshmi Mata Beings as loving and Durga Mata 3.2 Belief in caring in groups. paramatma. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Qualities Of Enlightened Beings using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Qualities Of Enlightened Beings in the examples.
2. Explain Qualities Of Enlightened Beings to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Qualities Of Enlightened Beings.
4. Show that you can: appreciate the qualities Parvati Mata, of the Enlightened Lakshmi Mata Beings as loving and Durga Mata 3.2 Belief in caring in groups. paramatma

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Qualities Of Enlightened Beings using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Qualities Of Enlightened Beings important for a Grade 1 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Be told names of Paramatma like Allah the Enlightened Beings and God from other faiths from the Pictures to
2. Be shown Images/animated stories the Enlightened Beings depicting the qualities of the Enlightened Beings. (4 lessons) to strengthen the belief

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. appreciate the qualities Parvati Mata, of the Enlightened Lakshmi Mata Beings as loving and Durga Mata 3.2 Belief in caring in groups. paramatma

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
